# Computer Science By Grace.CS — full summary

Computer Science By Grace.CS publishes free revision materials for two Cambridge Computer Science courses: IGCSE 0478 and AS & A Level 9618. There is no account or sign-up. The brand name is Computer Science By Grace.CS.

## What is free

Notes, slides, homework, original worksheets and a revision pack are read in an on-site reader (watermarked page images, no download button). Cambridge past-paper practice, mark schemes, Paper 4 week exercises and Word starter files remain downloadable. Everything is organised by official syllabus topic, with search and filters on each level page.

## IGCSE Computer Science 0478

Page: https://gracemchomvu.github.io/computer-science-by-grace-cs/igcse-0478.html

For Year 10 and Year 11. Covers data representation, data transmission, hardware, automated and emerging technologies, algorithm design and problem-solving, programming and Boolean logic, plus end-of-term revision, tests and mark schemes.

## AS Level Computer Science 9618

Page: https://gracemchomvu.github.io/computer-science-by-grace-cs/as-9618.html

For Year 12, AS topics 1–12: hardware, processor fundamentals, system software, security, ethics, databases, algorithms, data types, programming and software development, with worksheets, quizzes and mark schemes.

## A Level Computer Science 9618

Page: https://gracemchomvu.github.io/computer-science-by-grace-cs/a-level-9618.html

For Year 13, A Level topics 13–20 (data representation, communication and internet technologies, hardware and virtual machines, system software, security, artificial intelligence, computational thinking and further programming), plus a four-week Paper 4 practical programme with notes, past-paper style exercises, Python evidence starter files and a full practice paper.

## Premium plans

Page: https://gracemchomvu.github.io/computer-science-by-grace-cs/premium.html

Optional paid help on top of the free materials. Prices are not published on the site.

- Basic: worked video solutions to past papers, topic quizzes with instant marking, a monthly downloadable revision pack, and the protected online notes and slides
- Pro (most popular): everything in Basic, plus timed practice exams personally marked with feedback, a weekly live group revision class, and a WhatsApp Q&A group
- Exam Bootcamp: an intensive 4 to 6 weeks before the May/June and Oct/Nov series, with a Paper 2 and Paper 4 programming focus, exam technique and targeted past-paper practice
- One-to-one tutoring: personal online lessons on weak topics, with flexible scheduling

Ask for pricing on WhatsApp or by email. Each plan on the Premium page has a ready-made message.
